import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*np.sqrt(t) + p[3]*np.tanh(v) + p[4]*v + p[5]*v**2 + p[6]*v**3
            + p[7]*x + p[8]*x*v + p[9]*np.exp(-x)*v**3)
